chunks.arabic_text: سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، الْمُنْقَرِيُّ، الْأَصْبَهَانِيُّ. ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا، لَا يُلْتَفَتُ إِلَيْهِ، يُوضَعُ كَثِيرًا عَلَى الْمُهُمَّاتِ.

translations.en: Sulayman ibn Dawud, al-Munqari, al-Isbahani. Very weak, he is not regarded, he fabricates much upon the important ones.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghada'iri's *Kitab al-Du'afa* identifies Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Munqari al-Isbahani as a 'very weak' narrator whose reliability is negligible, specifically highlighting his tendency to fabricate hadith on major theological or legal issues. In Shia hadith criticism, such a designation warns against using his narrations for establishing doctrine, as his fabrications may have influenced early Shi'ite jurisprudence or creedal debates.
en.seo_question: What is the reliability status of Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Munqari in Shia hadith sciences?

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ جِدًّا: Very weak (a technical term for low reliability in narrators)
key_terms.يُوضَعُ: He fabricates (specifically referring to fabricating hadith)
